body:
Fixes #199

## Changes

- Wrap local LiNo and binary imports and mutating queries in one transaction in the Rust, C#, and JavaScript CLIs. An import and query in the same invocation share the transaction, including with `--vc`.
- Roll back the batch on a command error. An unchanged LiNo import leaves the journal byte for byte unchanged.
- Checkpoint the store and names once per changed batch. Sync the commit decision before the checkpoint and the applied markers afterward. C# also syncs a single undo image before its first memory-mapped write and drains the async batch checkpoint before closing.

## Reproduce and verify

```bash
work=$(mktemp -d)
for i in {1..10}; do printf '(k%s: a%s b%s)\n' "$i" "$i" "$i"; done > "$work/in.lino"
clink --db "$work/data.links" --transactions --in "$work/in.lino" --trace > "$work/trace" 2>&1
grep -c 'Committed tx' "$work/trace"
```

The original JavaScript CLI produces 100 commits for this input. With the batch, each CLI produces one. The Rust and JavaScript regressions also count four file saves, covering the data and name files at open and at the batch checkpoint. A local Rust run with 100 named rows and `--retention sized:64` also produced one commit and four file saves.

The CLI regressions cover a changed import and a multi-link query sharing one commit, an unchanged re-import, and a malformed query rolling back the preceding import and preserving the version-control head. In the process-kill tests, a FIFO blocks the CLI before its commit. Reopening recovers the original named row and removes all pending rows and names. C# also checks that an export failure rolls back embedded trigger registration and that a successful async invocation has applied every transition when it exits. See the [case study](docs/case-studies/issue-199/README.md).

Local verification passed the 27 focused Rust tests, 97 focused C# tests, the JavaScript server's 100% coverage gate, 15 Rust–JavaScript differential tests, and the repository parity check. The follow-up C# coverage run passed 24 focused tests and exercised all four branch outcomes on the line flagged by Codecov. Rust formatting and Clippy, JavaScript quality and repository tests, and the secrets scan also passed.

All 14 workflows passed on commit `63f8fa3d`, including the Rust and C# matrices on Linux, macOS, and Windows. Codecov reports coverage for every changed coverable line. [PR checks](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/pull/205/checks) · [Coverage report](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/pull/205#issuecomment-7225279659)

The initial PR checks failed the layout test because the generated branch contained a root `.gitkeep`. Its removal is included and the repository layout tests pass locally.

The `pre-commit` executable was unavailable. The applicable checks were run manually. The local .NET 10.0.112 whole-solution formatter reported whitespace findings in unchanged files. Formatting verification passed for every changed C# file. The C# workflow uses SDK 10.0.403.
title: Batch transactional CLI imports and queries
